Greetings weekend crew,
The lead dispatcher asked me to write about water breaks

Please treat this as urgent. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must stay steady through the full shift, because our travelers, their pets, and the ground teams depend on clear handling from booking through pickup. Keep water within reach at all times, step away in rotation, and return promptly so the desk is never left uncovered. If the queue builds, notify the senior coordinator before stepping out, and make sure the next person is ready to cover the line. We cannot afford delays, missed handoffs, or unclear messages while passenger and pet arrangements are active across Aurelia Skyways.

Also, keep the shared notes accurate and brief. If a traveler calls with a kennel concern, a feeding note, or an arrival change, enter the details cleanly and confirm them with care. Use calm language, avoid side conversations, and do not let fatigue turn into sloppy updates. If you are handling a case involving Willow, or any other pet with special needs, pass the relevant instructions directly to the next crew member before you leave the desk. When the work becomes crowded, pause only long enough to hydrate, then resume with full attention. I need everyone to remain professional, alert, and ready to support the next handoff without confusion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
